title: Amazing app
body:
This is an amazing app! I used to have such a hard time getting my kids to do basic tasks and chores, and even if they would start they wouldn’t complete. Joon has a nice way to gamify the task and chore management where the kids now WANT to do their stuff. They love getting the rewards for their achievements and show me their progress on the game. It is a little pricey for the annual fee but I found it worth it since both my daughter and son are now excited about their tasks. They do offer professional psychologists for support and coaching but that is extra fee which I didn’t opt for. 
The only negative is i have amazon fire tablets and the app doesn’t work on the kids profile.
author: Sahiba_9
